  \[
  -\frac{\sigma_{5d}}{\sigma_{60d}}
  \]
  The factor was intended to identify assets experiencing unusually low short-term volatility, potentially representing defensive or mean-reverting opportunities.

     `shift_1(sum(return, 20d) - sum(return, preceding 40d))`
   - Measures whether recent 20-day performance is accelerating relative to the prior 40-day period.
